The following applies to students 20 admitted to an approved practitioner preparation program on or 21 after July 1, 2027: 22 The section of this Act amending section 256.16. 23 EXPLANATION 24 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 25 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 26 This bill relates to practitioner preparation programs, 27 including by modifying the preparation required to be included 28 in practitioner preparation programs and the duties of the 29 state board of education (state board) and director of the 30 department of education (DE). 31 Current Code section 256.16 (specific criteria for teacher 32 preparation and certain educators) requires the state board 33 to adopt rules related to the duties of higher education 34 institutions providing practitioner preparation programs.
